Definition: something piled up (as if (figuratively) raised by mental aspiration), i.e. a paterre
KeyPassages: Song of Solomon 5:13; Song of Solomon 6:2; Ezekiel 17:10
BiblicalUsage: The bed is the garden bed, the plot where spices grow, and it is used for love and for judgment. The beloved's cheeks are as a bed of spices, he is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens; and Ezekiel asks if the vine planted in its beds shall prosper when the east wind touches it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the garden bed is a picture of tending: spices grow where someone plants and waters them, and a vine in a good bed still withers when the wind of God's judgment touches it. Love grows in a kept garden, and I hold that the same is true of the soul.
